issue_title: Proposed resort development in protected coastal landscape
description: Protesters and conservation groups opposed a luxury tourism development near the Narta–Zvërnec protected landscape, citing environmental damage and access concerns.
notes: Environmental impacts and permit claims require independent documentation.

issue_title: Protected areas law and strategic investment framework
description: Environmental campaigners challenged legal changes permitting development in protected areas and called for reversal of strategic-investment provisions.
notes: Policy issue; attach legal texts and amendment links when available.

issue_title: Concerns over Narta biodiversity and migratory birds
description: Conservation organizations raised concerns that coastal development could threaten sensitive habitats and migratory birds.
notes: Impact assessment and ecological evidence needed.

issue_title: Police used water and tear gas at early protests
description: Police used water and tear gas during demonstrations opposing the Zvërnec project; circumstances and proportionality should be assessed.
notes: Avoid characterizing the force as unlawful without investigation.

issue_title: High education costs and inadequate university conditions
description: Student organizers protested university conditions, rising costs, and insufficient financial support.
notes: Structural grievance rather than a single incident.

issue_title: Poor graduate job prospects
description: Students identified limited employment prospects after graduation as a central grievance.
notes: Add labor-market statistics separately.

issue_title: Tear gas and water cannon during student protests
description: Police deployed tear gas and water cannon amid clashes around the Education Ministry; protesters also threw stones and damaged property.
notes: Video report; assess specific instances individually.

issue_title: Arrests and criminal proceedings following demonstrations
description: Euronews reported 16 arrests and criminal proceedings involving 49 other people according to a police update.
notes: Figures reflect the reported police update, not a final total.

issue_title: Incidents affecting journalists and media workers
description: Association of Journalists of Albania documented at least 10 incidents affecting 12 media workers or teams across 13–14 October, involving police and protesters.
notes: Date covers 13–14 October; review individual cases in the source.

issue_title: Police reportedly obstructed a journalist filming
description: The Association of Journalists of Albania reported that Euronews Albania journalist Enkelejda Mema was obstructed by police while filming.
notes: Named allegation attributed to journalists association.

issue_title: Fire and damage at Education Ministry and nearby businesses
description: During escalated protests, the Education Ministry building and nearby properties were damaged by fires and vandalism.
notes: Record property damage without attributing actions to all protesters.

issue_title: Injuries to protesters, police and bystanders
description: Reporting described injuries among demonstrators and police during confrontations; casualty counts varied across dates and sources.
notes: Do not sum daily counts without deduplication.

issue_title: EU concerns over allegations of excessive police force
description: EU Delegation expressed concern about escalation and acknowledged allegations of excessive police force against protesters and journalists, calling for investigation.
notes: Follow up with original EU Delegation statement.

issue_title: Participation of high-school-age demonstrators
description: EFE reported that many demonstrators appeared to be teenagers of high-school age, raising questions about protection and safe handling of young participants.
notes: Do not identify minors in public images without appropriate safeguards.

issue_title: Calls for accountability and response to corruption allegations
description: The protest movement broadened from environmental opposition to calls for investigations into corruption allegations and political accountability.
notes: Claims are allegations; no finding of guilt implied.

issue_title: Faculty of Medicine joins class boycott
description: Students at the Faculty of Medicine boycotted classes and marched toward the Ministry of Education.
notes: Document participation; not a rights violation by itself.

issue_title: Polytechnic University students join boycott
description: Students from the Polytechnic University of Tirana joined the boycott and protest march.
notes: University-specific gallery entry.

issue_title: Law and economics faculties join marches
description: Students from law and economics faculties were reported to have boycotted classes and marched.
notes: Check individual faculty participation.

issue_title: Elbasan university faculty joins boycott
description: Faculty of Economics students at Aleksandër Xhuvani University joined class boycotts.
notes: Local university participation.

issue_title: Partizani high school class boycott
description: Classes at Partizani high school were reported boycotted during student mobilization.
notes: Avoid identifying individual minors.

issue_title: Student marches in Shkodër
description: Students boycotted classes and marched through Shkodër as protests expanded.
notes: Add local photo evidence if licensed.

issue_title: School boycotts in Korçë
description: Pupils in Korçë reportedly boycotted classes amid nationwide mobilization.
notes: Local school participation.

issue_title: School boycotts in Divjakë and Vlorë
description: Pupils in Divjakë and Vlorë were reported to have boycotted classes.
notes: Split into locality-specific entries when media available.

issue_title: Student demonstrations in Durrës
description: Student and pupil demonstrations and class boycotts were reported in Durrës.
notes: Add local corroboration.

issue_title: A2 CNN reporter and camera operator report police violence
description: Journalist Anesti Bajramemaj and camera operator Heri Simota reported police violence during protest coverage.
notes: Seek statements and any footage.

issue_title: Journalist injured by smoke device
description: AGSH reported that journalist Fatime Halmusaj suffered a leg injury after being struck by a smoke device launched by police.
notes: Seek medical documentation with consent.

issue_title: At least ten incidents against media teams
description: AGSH documented at least ten incidents affecting journalists and media workers across 13–14 October; includes police and protester conduct.
notes: Summary overlaps MED-01; do not double count.

issue_title: Masked protesters reportedly attack media crew
description: AGSH reported one incident involving an attack on a media crew by masked protesters.
notes: Distinguish from police-related incidents.
tags: press-freedom, journalist-safety, police, journalists, violence, investigation

issue_title: Press freedom groups seek investigations
description: CPJ and partner organizations called for investigation and accountability after reported police violence and obstruction against journalists.
notes: Advocacy response, not separate attack.

issue_title: Journalists reportedly pepper-sprayed at parliament protest
description: CPJ reports journalists covering a protest outside parliament were obstructed and some pepper-sprayed despite being identifiable as media.
notes: Earlier incident.

issue_title: Citizens.al reporter briefly detained
description: CPJ says Citizens.al journalist Vjolanda Peca was briefly detained while covering a protest in September.
notes: Exact date and location require follow-up.

issue_title: At least 23 arrests reported after October 13 protest
description: Al Jazeera reported at least 23 arrests following clashes at the Education Ministry.
notes: Different reporting windows may explain count differences.

issue_title: Videos raise concern over conditions inside police station
description: Exit reported circulated footage purportedly showing young detainees lying on the floor in a crowded police room, some apparently restrained.
notes: Verify footage provenance and privacy before reuse.

issue_title: Ombudsman opens inquiry into police force
description: Albanian Ombudsman announced an ex officio investigation into necessity and proportionality of police force during the protest.
notes: Investigation does not establish wrongdoing.

issue_title: Ombudsman monitors legal and medical access for detainees
description: Ombudsman teams monitored police facilities for access to counsel, family notification and medical examinations.
notes: Monitoring action, not confirmed deprivation.

issue_title: Civil society calls for independent inquiry into July detention allegations
description: Civil society organizations raised allegations of disproportionate force and obstacles to lawyers and medical exams after the July 2 protest.
notes: Do not describe allegations as established findings.

issue_title: Ombudsman investigates proceedings against June protesters
description: Ombudsman opened a review after activists complained that criminal proceedings were used to discourage peaceful protest.
notes: Inquiry outcome not established.

issue_title: Police officers and journalist injured in October 13 clashes
description: Police reported at least six injured officers and one injured journalist amid clashes.
notes: Verify figures against later updates.

issue_title: Fire at ministry and banks during October 14 protests
description: The Guardian reported fires affecting a government building and two banks during the protests.
notes: Separate individual property incidents when evidence obtained.

issue_title: EU delegation calls for de-escalation and inquiry
description: EU Delegation acknowledged allegations of excessive police force and urged investigation and de-escalation.
notes: Institutional response, not independent violation.
